description: The three states every remote resource has. Render exactly one of them with a `v-if` / `v-else-if` / `v-else` chain.
`true` for 2xx statuses. `fetch` resolves on 404 and 500, so check it and throw yourself.
Two in-flight requests resolving out of order, so an older response overwrites newer data.
Creates a `signal` you pass to `fetch`; calling `abort()` cancels the request and rejects it with an `AbortError`.
Vue 3.5+ API that registers cleanup for the current watcher run. Must be called before the first `await`.
